system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response:
Under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, the default interest rate was last set by an Emergency Decree effective April 11, 2021.

This decree set the rate at 3% per annum.

The law requires this rate to be reviewed every three years. As it is not possible to know the outcome of future reviews, it is not certain whether this rate will have been adjusted by August 2026.
